# Bid the panels, the knee wall, and the roof.

> Price a residential screened porch or lanai from the wall-screen square feet a floor-square-foot special cannot see, the knee wall, the roof, and the mesh — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
